scope: shared scene/edge SBT, payload, attribute, and pipeline compile contracts
shared reflection trace, segment visibility, and reflection EPC params/result layouts
shared reflection trace, segment visibility, and reflection EPC OptiX device programs
shared diffraction enums and common path/output/tape sub-layouts

ownership.shared: POD layouts, payload slots, compile counts, device helpers, and backend-neutral device program bodies
ownership.backend_adapters: constant params symbols, OptiX entry wrappers, policy differences, host pipeline/SBT, buffers, streams, and exception flags

device_policy_boundaries.reflection_trace: Dr.Jit keeps SoA/ray-major/no-tail-clear; Torch keeps AoS/packed/output-layout/tail-clear extensions
device_policy_boundaries.segment_visibility: Dr.Jit keeps always-enabled any-hit/no out_t write; Torch disables any-hit without ignores and writes out_t
device_policy_boundaries.reflection_epc: Torch disables any-hit when no ignore list is present; Dr.Jit keeps its previous any-hit behavior

known_boundaries: diffraction uses shared enums and validated common sub-layouts while backend-specific stride/staging outer params remain adapters
reflection and diffraction accumulation operation bodies remain scheduled for Share-6
scene/edge device programs share contracts and device helpers while tiered Torch and Dr.Jit hit-object adapters remain backend-specific
